pr452.body:
Thanks @sunnyriverr for #435 and #440. Two packaging items they don't cover, one commit each.
Commit 1, Qt majors: `796b9edd` paired a Qt 5 `btx-qt.real` with the Qt 6 `lib/qt6/plugins/platforms/libqxcb.so` (`1101e149` not checked), and on `36ab4300` neither `bundle_linux_qt` nor `verify_release_btxd.py --archive` checks the Qt major. `bundle_linux_qt` now refuses a `btx-qt` that doesn't link Qt 6 ("Configure with -DBUILD_GUI=ON -DWITH_QT_VERSION=6"; CMake still defaults to 5) and a platform plugin of another major. The gate fails an archive whose ELFs NEED libQt of two majors and names both sides. On `796b9edd` the same gate file reports "Qt 5 and Qt 6 in one archive: Qt 5 in btx-0.34.16/libexec/btx-qt.real (+4 libraries); Qt 6 in btx-0.34.16/lib/qt6/plugins/platforms/libqxcb.so (+3 libraries)" (Ubuntu 24.04, 7 Nov).
Commit 2, macOS guard: `FindPackagedGuardd()` looks beside the running executable on macOS too (`_NSGetExecutablePath`), and the macOS wrapper runs `libexec/btxd.real`, but the `libexec/btx-guardd` link is still made for `linux-*` only. It's now made for `macos-*` too. `set_linux_guard_runpath()` stays Linux-only, since it reads the guard as an ELF and raises on a Mach-O. #435's extraction test now also runs on the two macOS ids and checks that the RUNPATH edit runs for the Linux ids only.
Tested on macOS (arm64) with Python 3.12; `ldd`, `qtpaths` and `patchelf` are stubbed in the bundler tests. With only the test hunks on `36ab4300`, 4 cases fail: both bundler refusals, the gate's mixed-major case, and the extraction test on the macOS ids. The 2 positive controls pass both times, and with the commits everything passes: package 28 tests (1 skipped), gate 52 (4 skipped). cut_local, cut_release, bundle_manifest and publish are unchanged; issue_122 needs `ldd` and errors in setup on macOS, as it does on the base.
Not covered: no macOS archive was built or run (0.34.16 published none), no Linux archive was cut, and #440's native Linux test is skipped on macOS. Commit 1 refuses a Qt 5 archive but doesn't make one work; the Linux build still needs `-DWITH_QT_VERSION=6`.
Base `36ab4300`. Each commit applies and passes alone (package 28 and gate 52 for commit 1; 25 and 50 for commit 2), and both orders give the same tree. No C++ source, consensus or wallet change. Refs #432.
